name: Kernel Integrity Check
description: Checks kernel compilation signatures in /proc/version and uname, bootloader lock state from /proc/cmdline, and kptr_restrict address visibility in /proc/kallsyms.

evidenceUnits.title: Kernel and boot integrity posture
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Kernel build strings, version signatures, bootloader parameters, and kallsyms address visibility
evidenceUnits.proposition: An available kernel or boot observation matches a maintained integrity-posture rule
evidenceUnits.availability: Each observation depends on kernel configuration, procfs permissions, and platform exposure
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The running kernel owns all returned sources and can conceal or rewrite them
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A marker or visibility state is bounded evidence and does not prove a malicious custom kernel
